title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 016
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute loading and search variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Incomplete circular loading ring with a gap near the top right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple circular loader made from one incomplete stroke.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the dotted or multi ray spinners when the ring should stay as one arc.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a smooth circular arc with one open gap rather than dots or spokes.

items.depicts_observation: Twelve spoke loading star with short rounded rays around a center
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a loader made from separate short rays instead of one ring.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for circular arc or dotted spinners when the spoke shape matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces a ring with a full sunburst of short rounded spokes.

items.depicts_observation: Pale circular track with a dark progress arc near the top
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a loader with a visible background track and a highlighted active arc.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain ring when the light track behind the dark arc is visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uniquely includes a pale full ring behind a darker active progress arc.

items.depicts_observation: Circular ring with small dots spaced around the outer edge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants loading shown through a ring of separate dots.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for arc or spoke loaders when the dotted ring is the intended cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the only loading variant built from separate evenly spaced dots.

items.depicts_observation: Open magnifying glass ring with a spark star floating at upper right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the loosest search symbol with an open ring and an external spark cue.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for magnifying glass icons when the lens is open and the spark floats outside.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot breaks the circle into an open ring and adds a separate spark star at the top right.
